name: Scrutiny
description: Scrutiny is a dashboard for hard drive health based on S.M.A.R.T. data. It keeps the history of every disk, compares the values against real-world failure rates from Backblaze and sends notifications when a drive starts to fail.

notes.text: The container cannot read the disks. Run the Scrutiny Collector tool (tools/pve/scrutiny-collector.sh) on every machine whose disks you want to monitor and give it http://<container-ip>:8080.
The web UI has no login. Keep port 8080 inside your LAN or put it behind a reverse proxy with authentication.
